content: {"phoneNote":"Phone first screen works well: trade, area and the licence-plate phone number read in order, though the hero text sits on a busy tool photo with only a dark overlay to carry it.","desktopNote":"Desktop headline is oversized and pushes the phone number to the very bottom edge of the first screen, and the hero section stretches into a long dead band of photo below the tagline.","phone":{"impression":4,"hierarchy":4,"imagery":3,"spacing":4,"clutter":4,"distinctiveness":4},"desktop":{"impression":3,"hierarchy":3,"imagery":3,"spacing":3,"clutter":4,"distinctiveness":4},"fixes":["Desktop hero: shrink the headline by about a third so the phone-number plate and the price link fit inside the first screen, and cut the empty photo band below it.","Desktop 'Kaj popravljam' and 'Kako poteka' sections: the two-column list leaves a lonely fifth item and a half-empty right side; use a three-column grid or add a photo column.","Hero on both viewports: darken or blur the tool photo more under the text, or crop it to one side so the headline sits on a calm area."],"blockers":[]}
